title: Johny Johny, Yes Papa - The Pantry Door

voice_performance.performance_intent: Warm, playful call-and-response between a mischievous child and a gentle, amused father. Papa is slow and clear (a call-out); Johny is quick and bright with a giggle at the end.
voice_performance.energy_curve: Gentle start, playful rise through the Q&A, a warm giggle-resolution at the end. No aggressive peaks - cozy throughout.
voice_performance.pause_policy: 0.3s sentence silence. Papa lines get a slightly longer lead-in pause (0.4s) to feel like a deliberate call-out. Johny answers snap in quickly.

provider_notes.piper: Two voices: en_US-lessac-medium for Johny (length_scale 0.95, bright), en_GB-alan-medium for Papa (length_scale 1.05, warm). Keep lines short for clean mouth-shape approximation.

sections.label: Title card + establish kitchen
sections.speaker_directions: No dialogue. Title 'Johny Johny, Yes Papa' pops in over the cozy kitchen. Johny peeks out from behind the pantry door, grinning.

sections.label: Papa calls out
sections.text: Johny Johny, what are you doing in there?
sections.speaker_directions: Papa (warm, slow, amused). He leans against the pantry doorframe, one eyebrow up. Johny freezes mid-tiptoe, sugar on his nose.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Call-out phrasing, slightly raised at the end.

sections.label: Johny admits it
sections.speaker_directions: Johny (bright, quick, a little guilty). He takes a tiny lick of his finger, then beams. Sugar sparkles on his nose.

sections.label: Papa asks permission
sections.speaker_directions: Papa (playful, teasing). He tilts his head, smiling.

sections.label: Johny says yes
sections.speaker_directions: Johny (cheerful, unbothered). He gives a little nod and keeps nibbling.

sections.label: Papa asks what he saw
sections.text: Johny Johny, what did you see in there?
sections.speaker_directions: Papa (curious now). He peeks into the pantry, craning his neck. Johny's eyes dart around.

sections.label: Johny says nobody
sections.speaker_directions: Johny (wide-eyed, innocent). He shrugs with both little hands.

sections.label: Papa asks to tell
sections.speaker_directions: Papa (encouraging). He crouches down to Johny's level, open-handed.

sections.label: Johny says no no
sections.speaker_directions: Johny (shaking his head, giggly). He covers his mouth, trying not to laugh.

sections.label: Papa asks what he'll do
sections.text: Oh dear dear, what will you do?
sections.speaker_directions: Papa (feigning exasperation, still smiling). He puts a hand on his hip, laughing.

sections.label: Johny's big answer
sections.text: Sugar will rot your teeth, papa!
sections.speaker_directions: Johny (proud, pointing at Papa's teeth). He grins ear to ear, fully committed to his logic.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Big confident delivery, the payoff line.

sections.label: Papa's threat (loving)
sections.speaker_directions: Papa (laughing, pointing a finger). He's clearly delighted, not angry. He ruffles Johny's hair.

sections.label: Giggle + run off
sections.speaker_directions: No dialogue. Johny breaks into a big giggle and dashes off-screen through the pantry door. Papa shakes his head, smiling, following. Warm family beat.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Music swells gently; a soft giggle SFX.

sections.label: End card
sections.speaker_directions: No dialogue. End card: 'Johny Johny, Yes Papa' with a small 'Follow for more nursery rhymes' line. A sugar cube winks.

character_beats.johny: points at Papa's teeth, grins ear to ear

metadata.music: gentle lullaby bed, ducked under dialogue, swells at s12, fades at s13
